sourceText:
Aunt Caroline's Forgotten Cookies (Mae-Mae's Best Friend)
By: Mary Bogue
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 12:25am

Ingredients




2 egg whites
pinch of salt

3/4 cup sugar
6 cups ouncew package of ¾  chocolate chips

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 300 degrees. 2 Beat egg whites until frothy. 3 Add salt and beat until stiff. Add the suga a little at a time. Beat until stiff. 4 Fold in the chocolate chips. 5 Grease cookie sheet and drop tablespoons of the dough onto the sheet and place in oven. 6 TURN OFF OVEN IMMEDIATELY. 7 Go do some laundry, clear the ice off the sidewalk or take down your storm windows. Anything for 4 to 8 hours. 8 The cookies are now ready to eat. 9 Color may be added to the dough by adding 1-2 tsp. of Jello.

About


You know you want to try this!
